approved_by: architect (Codex) decision D2, after development results were seen
disclosure: Made AFTER the development decision-track results were seen. The original selections (rule A0: kappa = 1 only) are preserved below and are evaluated and reported in the final run, but they do not authorise a suggestion.
reason: D1 protects only the variability of demand inside the review window. With starting stock above the point forecast (kappa = 1.5) it counts the projected surplus as available, and development coverage fell to 0.601-0.833 for the cells where it was selected.
rule_A2: A candidate is eligible only if, with exact integer arithmetic, |hits - p*n| <= tol*n on every (L, R) pair and both scenarios at kappa = 1 AND on (7, 7) at kappa 0.5 and 1.5 in both scenarios, with >= 200 decisions per cell; tol = 0.05 (0.10 rare). Among eligible candidates the lowest mean order quantity at kappa = 1 is selected; none -> no suggestion.
correction_to_the_development_report: The report (section 6.3) read rounded coverages and stated that A2 would select D2c@0.9 for regular 90% and keep D2c@0.8 for occasional 80%. Exactly: D2c@0.9 regular reaches 0.848 at kappa 1.5 (below 0.85), so A2 selects D2@0.9; occasional 80% has no eligible candidate (D2c@0.8 reaches 0.852 at kappa 0.5, above 0.85).
decision_specific_quantity: Every candidate is evaluated on the order quantity it produces for each decision. Q_method - Q_D0 is not a safety stock: with Stage 2's daily checkpoints a safety-stock setting SS changes the quantity to max(-min balance, SS - end balance), which is not Q_D0 + SS in general. Any later implementation must reproduce the evaluated quantity for each decision.
excess_stock_gate: Per selected (segment, level): in every cell, shortage avoided per decision versus D0 > 0 and (mean end stock - D0 mean end stock) / (D0 mean lost units - mean lost units) <= cap, exactly; cap = 5/4 x the selected method's worst development ratio over all A2 cells; plus the date-block 95% interval of the pooled per-decision shortage reduction (kappa = 1) above 0.
